# evaluated condition

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:evaluatedCondition`](gmeow-evaluatedCondition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/evaluatedCondition>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The condition this evaluation reports on (⊑ [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) — the observation-spine bridge idiom). Functional: one evaluation, one condition; group members get their own evaluations.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ConditionEvaluation`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md) -> [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:evaluatedCondition`](gmeow-evaluatedCondition.md) from [`gmeow:ConditionEvaluation`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md) to [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md), [`gmeow:ConditionEvaluation`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md), [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`ConditionEvaluation`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md) to name the single condition it reports on — the observation's feature of interest.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one condition per evaluation (it is functional — group members get their own evaluations) and avoid naming the verdict here (that is [`gmeow:evaluationVerdict`](gmeow-evaluationVerdict.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:evaluatedCondition`](gmeow-evaluatedCondition.md) once from the evaluation to its [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md); it specializes [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md), so generic observation queries find it.
